falsification_tests.alternative_hypothesis: The intrusion-present condition shows a substantially higher fraction of depletion-present chunks than the intrusion-absent condition.
falsification_tests.null_hypothesis: The fraction of depletion-present chunks is equal in the intrusion-present and intrusion-absent conditions.
falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and code two indicators. Intrusion-present means the chunk contains at least one statement describing mental academic activity (worry, planning, re-reading, thinking through work) during a non-study context such as rest, leisure, family time, travel, or downtime. Depletion-present means the chunk contains at least one statement of being drained, numb, tired, unable to rest, unable to disconnect, or exhausted. Compare the fraction of chunks that are depletion-present between intrusion-present and intrusion-absent chunks.

falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and code two indicators. Fear-present means the chunk contains at least one statement about being scared of failing, worried about failing, or dreading outcomes. Tiredness-of-caring-present means the chunk contains at least one statement of reduced meaning (doesn't feel meaningful), tiredness of caring, or barely caring. Compare the fraction of tiredness-of-caring-present chunks between fear-present and fear-absent chunks.

falsification_tests.alternative_hypothesis: The self-cause framing class shows a substantially higher joint monitoring-and-comparison fraction than the external-cause class.
falsification_tests.null_hypothesis: The joint monitoring-and-comparison fraction is equal across the self-cause, external-cause, and neither framing classes.
falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and assign a framing class. Self-cause means the chunk frames difficulty as personal inadequacy (weaker, less capable, embarrassing, not good enough). External-cause means the chunk frames difficulty as external (buried under assignments, pile of work, deadlines). Neither means any other framing. Within each class, code two indicators: monitoring-present means at least one self-monitoring or mistake-tracking statement; comparison-present means at least one negative self-comparison statement (less capable than peers). Compare the fraction of chunks that are both monitoring-present and comparison-present across the three framing classes.

Self-cause means the chunk frames difficulty as personal inadequacy (weaker, less capable, embarrassing, not good enough). External-cause means the chunk frames difficulty as external (workload, deadlines, pile of work). Exclude chunks in the neither class. Depletion-present means the chunk contains at least one statement of being drained, numb, automatic, barely caring, or going through it. Compare the fraction of depletion-present chunks between the self-cause and external-cause conditions.

falsification_tests.alternative_hypothesis: High-distress chunks have a higher rest-time-intrusion-present fraction than lower-distress chunks.
falsification_tests.null_hypothesis: High-distress chunks have no higher rest-time-intrusion-present fraction than lower-distress chunks.
falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and assign distress level using a checklist covering the four thematic nodes (emotional distress, anxiety or stress, exhaustion or fatigue, self-doubt). A chunk is high-distress if it clearly expresses at least three of the four nodes and lower-distress if it expresses fewer than three. Rest-time-intrusion-present means the chunk contains at least one statement of mental academic activity during rest, leisure, family time, or downtime. Compare the rest-time-intrusion-present fraction in high-distress chunks with the lower-distress fraction.

falsification_tests.alternative_hypothesis: The rest-time-intrusion condition shows a meaningfully higher fraction of depletion-present chunks than the study-time-only-worry condition.
falsification_tests.null_hypothesis: The fraction of depletion-present chunks is equal between the rest-time-intrusion and study-time-only-worry conditions.
falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and code two mutually exclusive worry conditions. Rest-time-intrusion means mental academic activity during rest, leisure, family time, or downtime. Study-time-only-worry means worry while actively studying or planning with no rest-time intrusion. Exclude chunks matching neither condition. Depletion-present means the chunk contains at least one statement of being drained, numb, tired, unable to disconnect, or exhausted. Compare the fraction of depletion-present chunks between the rest-time-intrusion and study-time-only-worry conditions.

falsification_tests.alternative_hypothesis: The meaning-loss condition shows a substantially higher fraction of automatic-engagement-present chunks than the workload-only condition.
falsification_tests.null_hypothesis: The fraction of automatic-engagement-present chunks is equal between the meaning-loss and workload-only conditions.
falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and code two mutually exclusive conditions. Meaning-loss means the chunk contains at least one statement of loss of meaning (doesn't feel meaningful, used to like learning and now can't care, automatic engagement). Workload-only means workload-pressure statements (buried under assignments, pile never gets smaller) with no meaning-loss statement. Exclude chunks matching neither condition. Automatic-engagement-present means the chunk contains at least one statement of barely caring, going through it automatically, or low-effort automatic engagement. Compare the fraction of automatic-engagement-present chunks between the meaning-loss and workload-only conditions.

falsification_tests.alternative_hypothesis: The combined condition shows a substantially higher fraction of tiredness-of-caring-present chunks than the alone condition.
falsification_tests.null_hypothesis: The fraction of tiredness-of-caring-present chunks is equal between the combined and alone conditions.
falsification_tests.test_description: For each held-out chunk, read text_review and code three indicators. Fear-of-failure-present means at least one statement of being scared of failing or dreading outcomes. Meaning-loss-present means at least one statement of loss of meaning or doesn't feel meaningful. Tiredness-of-caring-present means at least one statement of tired of caring, barely caring, or automatic engagement. Form two conditions: combined means the chunk is both fear-of-failure-present and meaning-loss-present; alone means the chunk is fear-of-failure-present but not meaning-loss-present. Exclude chunks that are not fear-of-failure-present. Compare the fraction of tiredness-of-caring-present chunks between the combined and alone conditions.
